scope: every AlmaLaurea consortium university, by subject group and course level
note: Keyed <ateneo_code>|<group>|<level>. Institutions outside the consortium (Politecnico di Milano, Bocconi, all ITS academies) are absent by design — the site shows 'no survey data' for them rather than a substitute figure. Rows are the union of the national sharded pass and an earlier verified targeted pass; a value is never overwritten by a null, and the two agreed on every overlapping figure.
